description: Get class statistics for an assignment (mean, min, max, quartiles) next to your own score. Read-only. Canvas only shows these once enough students are graded and if the instructor allows it.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

name: get_score_statistics
title: Get Score Statistics
